What we haul

Four ways we move your freight

One call puts your cargo on the Atlas network — our own trucks plus a vetted bench of 340 carrier partners, dispatched from a single desk.

Full Truckload

A dedicated 53′ trailer for your freight alone — dock to dock, no transfers, no handling in between. Dry van, reefer and flatbed.

FROM $2.85 / MILE

LTL & Partials

Two pallets or twenty — share the trailer, not the headache. We consolidate partials on lanes we already run, so small freight moves at truckload speed.

FROM $0.42 / LB

Expedited & Team

Line-down freight, trade-show deadlines, just-in-time parts. Team drivers keep the wheels turning around the clock — coast to coast in under 48 hours.

QUOTE IN 15 MINUTES

Owner-Operator Dispatch

You drive, we do everything else: load hunting, rate negotiation, paperwork, invoicing and factoring. Keep 92% of every load — no forced dispatch, ever.

8% DISPATCH FEE

Eight hubs. One map.

Every Atlas load is routed through a hub network we watch in real time. If weather, traffic or a breakdown bends one route, dispatch redraws it through the next hub — your freight never sits waiting for a plan.

How it works

From quote to delivered in three stops

01

Book the load

Send the pickup, drop-off, cargo and weight through the quote form. You get a tracking number on the spot and a confirmed rate from a dispatcher within the hour.

02

We dispatch & track

Your load lands on the dispatch board, a vetted truck is assigned, and the route goes live in the tracker — booked, picked up, in transit, customs, out for delivery.

03

Delivered, signed, done

The driver checks in at every node. On delivery you get the signed proof of delivery and one clean invoice — no surprise accessorials, no chasing paperwork.
